home.hero: A simple international language: English-style words, Indonesian-style grammar, phonetic spelling.
home.concept1: Simpli is a proposed auxiliary language designed for egalitarian access to communication. It combines minimal grammar with familiar vocabulary so that more people can learn it quickly.
home.concept2: Whether you already know some English or are looking for a neutral bridge language, Simpli aims to reduce barriers of time, complexity, and geography.
